description: A three-track stereo loop station: the first track sets the length of the loop and the other two are locked to it

params.text: Reverses the direction all three tracks play in, on each press
Empties all three tracks and forgets the loop length, on each press
Silences all three tracks while keeping their length
Nothing in the module reads this button; the master CLEAR button silences this track, or use the jack beside it
Sets the level that track goes out at, from silence to twice
Starts recording the master track on the first press, stops it and starts everything playing on the second, and throws all three tracks away on the third
Starts recording over that slave track on each press and stops on the next; it does nothing until the master loop exists
Starts mixing the incoming signal into that track on each press and stops on the next

inputs.text: The left side of the signal to be recorded into whichever tracks are armed
The right side of the signal to be recorded into whichever tracks are armed
A rising edge reverses the direction all three tracks play in
On the master track a rising edge starts recording, the next stops it and starts everything playing, and a third throws all three tracks away and records afresh
On a slave track a rising edge starts recording over that track, and the next stops it; it does nothing until the master loop exists
A rising edge starts mixing the incoming signal into that track as it plays, and the next stops it
A rising edge empties all three tracks and forgets the loop length
A rising edge silences that track while keeping its length

outputs.text: The three tracks mixed, each at its own volume, with the incoming signal added while any track is recording
The three tracks mixed, each at its own volume, with the incoming signal added while any track is recording
That track alone, at its own volume; it carries nothing until the master loop exists

notes: nothing can be recorded onto the slave tracks until the master track has been recorded and stopped; the master sets the length that all three share.
the slave CLEAR buttons do nothing, and the master CLEAR button silences all three tracks rather than the master alone; the slave CLEAR jacks work as labelled.
a red lamp is lit while its track is recording or overdubbing, and all three green lamps come on together once the master loop exists.
CLEAR silences a track but keeps the loop running at its length; ERASE throws the length away as well.
overdubbing adds without scaling, so going round the loop again and again builds the level until it clips.
an edge is counted only when a jack moves away from exactly 0V, and no further edge until it returns there.
nothing is saved with the patch: reloading gives three empty tracks.
